domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form by matching denominators and/or normalizing whole or mixed numbers so like parts can be subtracted.
skills.merge_rationale: Inherited from the K=4 aggregation. These skills remain a coherent preparation phase.

skills.name: Execute subtraction with regrouping as needed
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction of aligned whole and fractional parts, including borrowing/regrouping when necessary to complete the computation.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a conditional extension of S03 rather than a separate phase in many worked solutions: students begin subtraction, detect an insufficient fractional part, regroup, and continue subtracting. Because borrowing is only invoked within the execution phase and directly supports completion of subtraction, these can be merged at a coarser level while still preserving a meaningful distinction between setup, computation, and finalization.

skills.name: Finalize and express result
skills.definition: Simplify the computed result and express it in the appropriate final form, including combining whole and fractional parts or reducing to 0 when needed.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final simplification and expression remain diagnostically distinct from both setup and computation, even at a coarse grain.
